The Chinese characters for Max

As a transliteration, Max is usually written 马克斯 (Mǎ kè sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

horse
克
kè

斯

Origin and meaning

From Latin, Max carries the meaning “greatest”.

About the name Max

A Latin name meaning 'greatest', short for Maximilian or Maxwell.
